WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE
ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED ON 18TH DAY OF JUNE 2019
The undersigned, being the Directors of Zameen Venture One (Private) L1mrted ("Company )
hereby consent to and adopt in writing the following resolutions as of this 18111 day of June, 2019
(1) Resolved that Zameen may proceed to issue and allot to EMPG Projects Holdings Limited
("EMPG") ordinary shares of Rs 10 (Rupees ten) of the Company against the Pakistani
Rupees equivalent of AED 23,650,000 (Emirati Dirham twenty-three million six hundred fifty
thousand) at the exchange rate applicable on the date of payment of subscription amount by
EMPG ("Shar es"), subject to mutually agreed terms and conditions of a share subscription
agreement to be executed by and between the Company and EMPG in compliance with
applicable law(s)
(2) Resolved further that lmran Ali Khan, acting as duly authorized representative of Zameen
is hereby authorized to enter into, sign, execute, delrver, and complete share subscnpt1on
agreement, including such other instruments and documents as may be necessary and proper
for closing of the transaction contemplated by the share subscription agreement. in
compliance with applicable law(s)
(3) Resolved further that lmran Ali Khan is hereby authorized to do all such acts as may be
necessary on behalf of the Company, from time to time, in order to issue and deliver to EMPG
the Shares and close the share subscription transaction of Shares.
We, the Directors of Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited, agree to passing of the above
resolutions and subscribe our signatures in token of our consent on this 18111 day of June, 2019.

Signed by lmran Ali Khan
for and on behalf of
Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited
